title: Working on a model generation UI - what features should I be adding? Any feedback appreciated! (not a promo)
author: spacespacespapce
selftext:
Looking for any input on what options, settings or buttons would be helpful to have on this page. If you're generating a model via text/images using Blender, what part of the process would you like to control? For ex Model complexity, textures/materials, negative prompts, etc..

So far I added generation "mode" which decides the speed/complexity in the model building phase, as well as a "memory" option to potentially reduce iterations (wip).

  
(not sharing a link here because I want to just get feedback. when I do launch I will make a separate post)

https://preview.redd.it/bq1qcljnsq0g1.jpeg?width=989&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=54bb4ad9c1c572cf923600c9b5eb1c512a6fcd62

Here is my layout for my website [https://www.autosprite.io/](https://www.autosprite.io/) where I make character animations / spritesheets for a character image.

I spent a lot of time figuring out which animations are important to people and put them as hardcoded “check marks” and then if they want to type they have custom.

I feel you get a lore better user retention and the user gets a better hardcoded prompt.

Good luck ! Hope it helps

replies.body:

I like the clean design you have, it's intuitive. Showing common settings as choices is a great idea, hoping I can implement something like it too.
